description: Reviewed allowlist for the reserve proof dispatch layer (_reserve_ReserveProof.dispatch_failures). Same exact-count semantics as reviewed-closure-allowlist.json: rows are matched by (category, path, symbol) with an exact row count; a changed count surfaces every row of that key, and a dropped count is reported stale.

entries.reason: Read-only getattr(self, field.name) over dataclasses.fields(self) of the frozen record; the selector is the declared field set, which the finite-selector analysis does not model.
Generic __post_init__ helper: read-only getattr(instance, name) after every name is checked against dataclasses.fields(instance); the caller-supplied selector is beyond the finite-selector analysis.
PEP 562 lazy re-export guarded by name in _ORCHESTRATOR_EXPORTS (a closed literal set); only the orchestrator package's types branch has a reviewed receipt.

RowPlugin branch of the lazy re-export whose whole body _reserve_orchestrator_type_export_reflection already pins; that receipt returns only the types-branch getattr, and the plugin_types branch is guarded by name in _PLUGIN_TYPE_EXPORTS ({'RowPlugin'}).

ComposerOperationFenceLost is a member of the module-level `|` union _ServiceFailure, used only by isinstance and annotations; a types.UnionType is immutable and the analysis models tuple type checks, not unions.

self.policy.segment.reserve is the float ContinuationSegmentPolicy.reserve, not the coordinator method; the scalar-read proof refuses receivers in a method that also writes self attributes (_subject_rebound).
